description: Tiered canonical header groups for format coverage summaries. Each group uses mode 'any' (at least one header mapped) or 'all' (every header mapped).

groups.label: Variant ID
groups.description: At least one variant identifier column (SNPID or rsID).

groups.label: Genomic location
groups.description: Both chromosome and base-pair position must be mapped.

groups.label: Effect / other allele
groups.description: Both effect allele and non-effect allele must be mapped.

groups.label: Effect size
groups.description: At least one effect-size statistic (beta, odds ratio, hazard ratio, or Z-score).

groups.label: Uncertainty
groups.description: Standard error of the effect estimate.

groups.label: Sample size
groups.description: Total sample size or case count (case-control studies may also map N_CONTROL separately).

groups.label: Allele frequency
groups.description: Effect, minor, or non-effect allele frequency.
